question: Aarti got a new bed at 50% discount. If Aarti did not get any discount, Aarti would have to pay ₹8,453 extra. So how much did Aarti pay for the bed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let marked price = x

50% discount ⇒ paid = x/2

Extra amount without discount = x − x/2 = x/2

⇒ x/2 = 8453 ⇒ x = 16906

Paid amount = x/2 = 8453

**∴ Answer = ₹8453**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Discount = 50%

Extra amount without discount = 8453

**Formula used:**

Discount = MP − SP

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let marked price = x

⇒ Selling price (after 50% discount) = x/2

⇒ Difference = x − x/2 = x/2

⇒ x/2 = 8453

⇒ x = 16906

⇒ Amount paid = x/2 = 8453

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8453.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Concept

50% discount means half price

Difference Logic

Extra amount equals discount amount

Reverse Calculation

Find original price from given difference

Key Insight

Half of marked price equals given extra amount
